mapper.select: SELECT /*Mail.retrieveMailInfo*/ seq_id, sender_email_addr, receipt_email_addr, cc_email_addr, mail_clob_data, mail_clob_content, subject_content, mail_id, language_code, file_name FROM LGCOM_MAIL_INFO WHERE STATUS_CODE = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE /*Mail.updateMailInfo*/ LGCOM_MAIL_INFO SET status_code = #{status}, mail_clob_content = #{mailClobContent}, /* 실제 메일로 발송된 최종 문장을 저장한다. */ subject_content = #{subjectContent}, error_reason_desc = #{errorReasonDesc} WHERE seq_id = #{seqId}
